description: This file defines a React component named 'LoadingState' that displays a loading indicator, current workflow step, a log of workflow notes with timestamps, and associated tags. It manages UI rendering for a loading state during an evaluation process.

methods.name: getTagVariant
methods.description: Returns a variant string ('default', 'secondary', 'outline') based on the input tag, used for styling badges.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string into a relative time string (e.g., '5m ago', 'now').
